limits: Real OS key/mouse delivery to winit was not exercised. Computer Use app access was not approved; only application-local input/controller verification is available.
Presentation acceptance, Vulkan maintenance fence and D3D12 queue marker do not establish physical display completion. PresentMon/scanout latency not measured.
1ms explicit event-loop retry scheduling remains active; this is a small real-window baseline, not a maximum-FPS or Bistro benchmark.
No fixed clock/affinity/power plan, other GPU/driver, Linux real GPU, actual OOM/device loss, HDR output, general scaling, Bistro PBR/shadows/tone mapping/Bloom.
Native shipping Disabled is a request; external layer/driver injection absence not proven. Driver/OS allocations outside Renderer hooks are unobserved.
Vulkan TOP_OF_PIPE/BOTTOM_OF_PIPE and D3D12 BOP timestamps retain their native interval semantics; no shader occupancy or universal API ranking claim.
